about: Human review decisions on extracted citation edges, applied by scripts/build_graph.py through the same review write the UI and MCP use (they override the extraction audit). Only decisions made by a named person belong in `reviews`; each needs a `reviewer` naming that person and the evidence in `note`. There are none yet. `ai_generated_not_applied` keeps, for the record, four earlier decisions that were labelled 'curated human review' but were generated by an AI agent; they are never applied as human reviews. Their links are governed by the extraction audit (data/audit/link_decisions.json): K092835 -> K991646 is an audit error; the three K093416 links are audit-unresolved and stay in the lineage, flagged, until a person decides them.
